name: 分裂強調句 It is…that
formula: It is/was + 被強調部分（名詞／介片／副詞子句）+ that + 其餘句子
zh: 把主詞、受詞或時間地點原因拿出來強調「正是…」。拿掉 It is…that 後句子必須仍完整。
ex: It was the volunteers' patience that turned the event into a success. 正是志工的耐心讓這場活動成功。
traps: 強調句與倒裝混用：*It is because we cooperate can we succeed（他 每日2）→ It is because we cooperate that we can succeed；或改 Only because…can we
被強調的是人時可用 who，但不可用 which
拿掉 It is…that 後殘缺＝不是強調句（應是虛主詞句）
evidence: 他 全真5 中譯英能用 It is not until…that
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=2/4/13/4/11
南一第08、10回、3800 p.95、龍騰 p.87 文章皆有 It was…that

name: 越…越… the 比較級, the 比較級
formula: The + 比較級 (+ S + V), the + 比較級 (+ S + V)
zh: 兩件事成比例變化。注意形容詞／副詞與它修飾的名詞要一起移到前面。
ex: The more carefully you plan your schedule, the less stressed you will feel. 時間規劃得越仔細，你會越不焦慮。
traps: 比較級與所修飾的名詞拆開：The more you read books → The more books you read
*the easier people can（他 全真5）→ the more easily people can
後半句漏 the 或用 will 放前半句
evidence: 他 全真5、每日2 中譯英考過（已會但有詞性錯）
龍騰 p.28 綜合測驗 18 選項 more closely; highly
南一第05、09、10、11回；3800 The more people are vaccinated, the more likely…
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=0/1/4/7/2

name: 比較對等（平行結構）
formula: A … than / rather than / as … B：A、B 詞性／形式相同（V-ing 對 V-ing，to V 對 to V，名詞對名詞）
zh: 比較或對照的兩邊必須同形式，比較對象也要同類（the price of A vs that of B）。
ex: For many students, keeping a daily routine is harder than starting a new habit. 對很多學生來說，維持日常作息比開始新習慣更難。
traps: *harder than apologize（他 全真3）→ than apologizing
比較對象不同類：The weather here is hotter than Tainan → than that in Tainan
rather than 後形式不一致
evidence: 他 全真3 中譯英錯、全真4 已會
官方 111-16 other than 平行；南一第01、04、10回 rather than 選項
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=2/3/8/5/4

name: 與過去事實相反
formula: If + S + had + p.p., S + would/could/might + have + p.p.
zh: 說過去沒發生的事；兩邊時態後退一格。
ex: If we had left ten minutes earlier, we would have caught the last train. 要是我們早十分鐘出門，就趕得上末班車了。
traps: *would arrived（他 全真3 作文）→ would have arrived
If 子句寫 would have
主要子句漏 have
evidence: 官方 110-25：If he was, the first bolt __25__ enough（選 would have been）
114 作文範文 Had the government declared…could have been avoided
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=4/7/11/5/3

name: 過去完成式與「過去的未來」
formula: had p.p.（過去的過去）；was/were going to V、would V（過去看未來）
zh: 敘事時區分先後；描述「當時即將…」用 would。
ex: None of them knew the small meeting would change the company's future. 他們當時都不知道這次小會議會改變公司的未來。
traps: 過去完成式濫用
過去的未來誤用 will
*was going 漏 be（他 全真3 作文）
evidence: 官方 114-11 had spread / would spread / had been spreading / would have spread（選 would spread）
南一第08回 20 Yet Utzon __20__ his finished masterpiece before his death（had never seen）
南一第04回 11 had doubled 等選項

name: 分詞構句（主動 V-ing／被動 p.p.）
formula: V-ing… / p.p.…, S + V（分詞的邏輯主詞＝主要子句主詞）
zh: 把副詞子句簡化；主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.。中譯英與綜合測驗都高頻。
ex: Encouraged by her teacher, Mia entered the speech contest. 受到老師鼓勵，Mia 報名了演講比賽。
traps: 分詞主詞與主要子句主詞不一致（懸垂分詞，他 每日2 作文）
主被動判斷錯
分詞構句前又加 and
evidence: 107 中譯英 Bracing for a typhoon, we need to…
108 中譯英 Operational since 2007, the High Speed Rail…（形容詞片語前置）
官方 113-17 __17__ sticks or pea shooters（Equipped with）
龍騰 p.7 13 Rising / By rising / Rise / To rise
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=7/16/18/11/8

name: with + 受詞 + 分詞／形容詞／介片
formula: with + O + V-ing（主動）/ p.p.（被動）/ adj / 介系詞片語
zh: 表附帶狀況或原因，句子更精簡。
ex: With the deadline approaching, the team worked late every night. 隨著截止日逼近，團隊每晚加班。
traps: 主被動錯：with their antennae touched（他 全真4-13，應 touching）
with + O + 原形動詞
with + 子句
evidence: 官方 114-12 With their plan __12__ by the rain（選 disrupted）
南一第05、07、14回 with the population rising / with her pockets bulging
龍騰 p.57 with the world getting smaller
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=1/2/12/4/3

name: 分詞片語後位修飾（關係子句省略）
formula: N + V-ing（主動）/ p.p.（被動）＝ N + which/who + be + …
zh: 名詞後接分詞片語修飾，是中譯英「…的」最常用寫法。
ex: Many products sold online come with hidden delivery fees. 很多網路販售的商品附帶隱藏運費。
traps: 保留 which 卻漏 be：*which then believed（他 全真1-19）
主被動錯：the joy bringing by pets
evidence: 官方 110-20 the pills were placed in 40 bird feeders __20__ throughout the city（選 installed）
111 中譯英 the joy brought by pets；112 中譯英 the goal pursued by all human beings
他 全真1 綜合測驗19 錯

name: 動名詞／不定詞作主詞
formula: V-ing … + 單數動詞；To V … + 單數動詞；It is … to V（虛主詞替代）
zh: 以動作當主詞，動詞用單數。不可用介系詞片語當主詞。
ex: Keeping a journal helps many students organize their thoughts. 寫日記幫助許多學生整理思緒。
traps: *By reading books can…（By + V-ing 不能當主詞，他 全真4 作文）
主詞動詞不一致：Keeping pets are
用原形當主詞：Keep pets is
evidence: 111 中譯英 Keeping pets is not…
112 中譯英 To avoid / Avoiding conflicts and ensure world peace should be the goal…

name: 關係代名詞限定子句 who／which／that
formula: N + who / which / that + (S) + V
zh: 修飾名詞；中譯英「…的 N」最核心。
ex: The magical tools that once appeared only in novels are now part of daily life. 曾只出現在小說中的神奇工具，現在已成為日常的一部分。
traps: 關係子句後主要動詞漏寫或主詞重複（他 全真5 作文 if students who…）
人用 which
主詞動詞一致錯
evidence: 114 中譯英 The magical items / objects that once appeared in sci-fi movies are now…（114 評分原則：第二句須用關係子句）
3800 p.176 參考答案 advertisements that promote…

name: 介系詞 + 關係代名詞（in which / to which / each of which）
formula: N + 介系詞 + which / whom + S + V；數量詞 + of + which/whom
zh: 介系詞由動詞或名詞的搭配決定（be assigned to → to which）。
ex: The town in which I grew up has changed beyond recognition. 我長大的小鎮已變得認不出來。
traps: 介系詞後用 that
介系詞選錯（看搭配）
*within each of which 誤選（他 每日2）——需判斷後面子句是否缺介系詞受詞
evidence: 官方 113-12 the stores __12__ they are assigned（選 to which）
南一第03回 18 which / that / to which / to where
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=9/16/17/8/13

name: that 名詞子句（作受詞／主詞／同位語）
formula: S + V + that 子句；The fact that… ；It + V + that…
zh: 表達「說、認為、證明…」，中譯英常用。
ex: Studies show that teenagers need at least eight hours of sleep. 研究顯示青少年至少需要八小時睡眠。
traps: 介系詞後接 that 子句（他 全真5 shocked by that…→ by the fact that）
*criticize that（他 全真5 作文，criticize 不接 that）
that 子句時態不一致
evidence: 112 中譯英 History proves repeatedly that wars will cause…
3800 p.129／p.136 參考答案 suggested that…／indicates that…

name: 間接問句（疑問詞 + S + V）
formula: S + V + wh- / whether / if + S + V（不倒裝）
zh: 問句放進句子裡要改成直述句語序。
ex: Few people know where their donations actually go. 很少人知道自己的捐款實際流向哪裡。
traps: *where do their money be spent（他 全真5）→ where their money is spent
保留 do/does/did
句尾仍打問號
evidence: 他 全真5 中譯英錯
南一（21 次）等文章常見
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=8/11/21/7/7

name: 結果 so…that／such…that
formula: so + adj/adv + that…；so + many/much/few/little + N + that；such + (a) + adj + N + that
zh: 表「如此…以致於」。so 接形容詞，such 接名詞。
ex: The lecture was so inspiring that many students stayed to ask questions. 演講太精彩，很多學生留下來發問。
traps: such 接形容詞
so a good movie（應 such a good movie / so good a movie）
that 子句漏寫
evidence: 他 全真5 詞彙7 忽略 so 表結果而選錯
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=1/3/4/3/1

name: 不但…而且 not only A but (also) B／B as well as A
formula: not only A but (also) B（A、B 對等；動詞與 B 一致）；B as well as A（動詞與 B 一致）
zh: 表遞進；A、B 必須同詞性。
ex: The program not only teaches coding but also builds teamwork. 這個課程不只教程式，也培養團隊合作。
traps: A、B 不對等（他 全真4 作文 not only…but also 錯）
主詞動詞一致錯
句首 Not only 未倒裝
evidence: 官方翰林歷屆書內 6 篇；南一 12、3800 10
龍騰 p.57 Not only do they cover…
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=6/11/26/14/18

name: 轉承語判斷（However / Therefore / Instead / In fact / As a result）
formula: 句1. 轉承語, 句2.（依兩句邏輯：轉折、因果、舉例、補充、替代、總結）
zh: 綜合測驗必考：先判斷前後句關係再選。轉承副詞不能連接兩個子句（需句號或分號）。
ex: The plan seemed perfect. In practice, however, it caused several problems. 這計畫看似完美，但實際上造成好幾個問題。
traps: *for example 位置選 however（他 每日2）
看到轉折字就選、未讀完分號前後（他 全真5）
用 however 連接兩子句只加逗號
evidence: 官方 114-15 still / also / further / thus（選 thus）；114-20 as well / by far / at least / after all
翰林歷屆 109-19 moreover / altogether / namely / otherwise；108-28 beforehand / likewise / instead / therefore；107-29 In other words / By no means…
南一第05、11、12回；3800 p.58 On the contrary / As a result…

name: 使役 make／have／let + O + 原形
formula: make / have / let + O + 原形 V；被動 be made to V
zh: 使某人做某事；make 被動時要加 to。
ex: The coach made the players run ten extra laps. 教練讓球員多跑十圈。
traps: *making students to clean（他 全真5 作文）
let + O + to V
被動 be made clean（漏 to）
evidence: 他 全真5 作文錯
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=14/26/43/33/32

name: cause／allow／enable／force／encourage + O + to V
formula: cause / allow / enable / force / encourage / remind / ask / expect + O + to V
zh: 這類動詞不接原形；cause 不能當連接詞。
ex: The new policy allows students to choose their own electives. 新政策讓學生自選選修課。
traps: *cause we waste（他 每日2）→ cause us to waste
allow + O + V（help 例外：help + O + (to) V 皆可）
evidence: 他 每日2 作文、全真3 中譯英錯
官方 112-11 段 photosynthesis may allow trees to increase…

name: 助動詞／to 後接原形
formula: can / will / would / should + 原形；to + 原形；do/does/did + 原形
zh: 最基本但作文最常扣分。
ex: The new rule will change the way we use our phones at school. 新規定將改變我們在校使用手機的方式。
traps: *will changed（他 每日2）
*to hired / to arrived（他 全真3、全真5）
*where do their money be spent
evidence: 他 全真3、全真5、每日2 作文連續出現

name: 堅持／應付類 V + 介副詞片語句構
formula: stick to / stick with / cope with / deal with / put up with + N/V-ing；result in（導致）vs result from（起因於）
zh: 片語動詞方向與介系詞：結果在後用 result in，原因在後用 result from。
ex: Poor sleep can result in lower concentration. 睡眠不足可能導致專注力下降。
traps: result in / from 方向弄反（他 App）
stick with vs put up with（他 全真1-12）

name: It is not until…that（直到…才）
formula: It is/was not until + 時間／子句 + that + S + V（肯定）
zh: 表「直到…才…」；that 後動詞用肯定，時態跟 is/was 一致。中譯英高頻。
ex: It was not until she moved abroad that she realized how much she missed home. 直到搬到國外，她才發覺自己多想家。

name: 最高級（+ 現在完成式 ever）

than 後形式不對等
evidence: 他 每日2 中譯英 would rather…than 已會
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=2/3/8/5/4

name: 與現在／未來事實相反
formula: If + S + were / V-ed, S + would/could + V；If + S + were to V, …
zh: 說現在不可能或可能性很低的情況。
ex: If I were the principal, I would let students design part of the curriculum. 如果我是校長，我會讓學生設計部分課程。
traps: If I was（正式寫作用 were）
主要子句用 will
were to 與 used to 混淆
evidence: 官方 111-17 選項 were to be / used to be（考時態與語意辨別）
作文高頻（如果我是…）

name: wish／as if 假設
formula: S + wish + S + 過去式／had p.p.；as if / as though + 假設語氣
zh: 表與事實相反的願望或「好像」。
ex: He talks as if he had seen the accident himself. 他說得好像他親眼看到那場意外。
traps: wish 後用現在式
as if 後時態未後退
evidence: 語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=0/2/1/4/4

name: 要不是 Without／But for／If it were not for
formula: Without / But for + N, S + would (have) …；If it were/had been not for N…
zh: 用名詞片語代替 if 子句表假設。
ex: Without the coach's encouragement, the team would have given up. 要不是教練的鼓勵，球隊早就放棄了。
traps: Without 後接子句
If it is not for（時態未後退）
evidence: 龍騰 p.87 If it __20__ not for the park, the island's economy would not be…（選 were）

name: 建議、要求動詞 + that + (should) 原形
formula: suggest / insist / demand / recommend / require + that + S + (should) + 原形；It is essential/important that S (should) V
zh: 表建議、命令的 that 子句用原形（省略 should）。
ex: The doctor recommended that he get more sleep. 醫生建議他多睡一點。
traps: he gets / he got
suggest + O + to V（suggest 不接不定詞）
insist 表「堅稱事實」時不用原形
evidence: 3800 p.129 中譯英參考答案 A UN report suggested that smartphones (should) be banned from schools

name: 花費 spend／It takes
formula: S + spend + 時間/錢 + (in) V-ing / on N；It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V；S + cost + 人 + 錢
zh: 三種「花費」主詞不同：spend 主詞是人，take 用虛主詞 it，cost 主詞是物。
ex: It took the volunteers three days to clean up the beach. 志工花了三天清理海灘。
traps: spend + to V
*I take three hours to…（中式）
cost 主詞用人
evidence: 南一（8 次）、龍騰（7 次）文章常見
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=0/1/9/4/8

name: 有困難 have trouble／difficulty／a hard time + V-ing
formula: have trouble / difficulty / a hard time / problems + (in) V-ing
zh: 表做某事有困難，後接 V-ing。
ex: Many new students have trouble adjusting to the school schedule. 許多新生難以適應學校作息。
traps: have difficulty to V
have a hard time on V-ing
evidence: 3800 p.176 中譯英參考答案 have a hard time asking for a refund

name: 阻止 keep／prevent／stop／ban + O + from V-ing
formula: keep / prevent / stop / ban / discourage + O + from + V-ing
zh: 表阻止、禁止某人做某事。
ex: Heavy rain kept the fans from entering the stadium on time. 大雨讓球迷無法準時進場。
traps: 漏 from
from + 原形
ban 誤用 ban O to V
evidence: 3800 p.136 中譯英參考答案 France bans… from having any plastic…
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=3/5/17/11/0

name: 最後落得 end up + V-ing
formula: S + end up + V-ing / in N / with N
zh: 表「最後卻…」，閱讀與中譯英常用。
ex: We planned to eat out but ended up cooking at home. 我們本想外食，最後卻在家煮飯。
traps: end up to V
end up + 原形
evidence: 3800 p.176 中譯英參考答案 end up receiving fakes

name: V + to V／V-ing 意義不同（remember / forget / stop / try / regret）
formula: remember/forget to V（未做）vs V-ing（已做）；stop to V（停下來去做）vs stop V-ing；try to V vs try V-ing
zh: 同一動詞接不同形式意思不同。
ex: I'll never forget visiting Hualien with my grandparents. 我永遠忘不了和祖父母去花蓮的那趟旅程。
traps: stop to smoke 與 stop smoking 混
regret to tell vs regret telling
evidence: 官方 113-20 forget / change / match / regret（語意＋句構）

name: those who／anyone who
formula: those who + V（複數）；anyone who + V（單數）；whoever ＝ anyone who
zh: 指「…的人們」，中譯英高頻。
ex: Those who volunteer regularly often feel more connected to their community. 經常當志工的人往往和社區更有連結。
traps: those who 搭單數動詞
*people who…, they…（主詞重複）
evidence: 108 中譯英 For those who emphasize workplace efficiency
3800 p.150 參考答案 For people (those) who enjoy natural scenery

name: whose 所有格關係代名詞
formula: N + whose + N + V
zh: 表「…的（所有）」。
ex: Students whose parents work late often eat dinner alone. 父母晚下班的學生常獨自吃晚餐。
traps: whose 後漏名詞
用 who's
evidence: 南一（9 次）、龍騰（4 次）文章
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=0/0/9/2/4

name: What 名詞子句
formula: What + (S) + V ＝ the thing(s) that…；What matters is…
zh: what 本身含先行詞，不可再加名詞。
ex: What surprised me most was the kindness of strangers. 最讓我驚訝的是陌生人的善意。
traps: *the thing what
what 與 that 混用
evidence: 翰林歷屆 107 綜合測驗 26 what / why / when / which
南一第01、06回、3800 p.78 That / What / It / Which
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=2/1/5/4/7

name: whether／if 名詞子句
formula: S + V + whether (or not) + S + V；Whether…or not, S + V（讓步）
zh: 表「是否」；句首、介系詞後只能用 whether。
ex: Whether we win or lose, we should respect our opponents. 不論輸贏，我們都應尊重對手。
traps: 介系詞後用 if
Whether…or not 與 No matter 混用
evidence: 113 綜合測驗篇 Whether they wielded rods or pea shooters
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=3/7/11/8/16

name: 複合關係詞與 no matter
formula: whatever / whoever / wherever / however + adj + S + V ＝ no matter what/who/where/how
zh: 「無論…」；however 後接形容詞或副詞。
ex: However busy you are, you should make time for exercise. 無論多忙，你都應撥時間運動。
traps: *No matter how you are busy（語序）
no matter 與 whatever 疊用
evidence: 語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=4/9/16/5/12

name: There be + N + 分詞／關係子句
formula: There + be + N + V-ing / p.p. / that…
zh: 引出存在的人事物並補充說明。
ex: There are many students struggling to balance study and sleep. 有很多學生苦於兼顧讀書和睡眠。
traps: *There have many students（中式「有」）
there be 後又接動詞原形
evidence: 3800 p.176 參考答案 There are often advertisements that promote…
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=2/3/8/3/14

name: too…to／enough to
formula: too + adj/adv + (for sb) + to V；adj/adv + enough + (for sb) + to V
zh: too…to 表「太…而不能」，enough 放形容詞後。
ex: The box was too heavy for the child to carry. 箱子太重，小孩搬不動。
traps: too…to 後再加 not
enough 放在形容詞前（enough old）
to V 後重複受詞（to carry it）
evidence: 語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=7/7/14/0/7

name: either / neither / both 對等連接
formula: either A or B / neither A nor B（動詞與 B 一致）；both A and B（複數）
zh: 對等連接詞的主詞動詞一致。
ex: Neither the students nor the teacher was aware of the change. 學生和老師都沒察覺這項改變。
traps: neither…or
動詞與 A 一致
neither 後再加 not
evidence: 語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=8/12/20/18/32

name: 除了／而非 other than／except (for)／rather than／instead of
formula: other than / except (for) / apart from + N；rather than / instead of + N/V(-ing)
zh: 區分「除了（排除）」「除了（包含）」與「而不是」。
ex: Instead of complaining, he started looking for solutions. 他不抱怨，而開始找解決辦法。
traps: besides（包含）與 except（排除）混
instead of + 原形
evidence: 官方 111-16 contrary to / except for / more of / other than（選 other than）
南一第01、04、09、10回；3800 p.58 in addition to / except for / instead of / as well as；龍騰 p.47 apart from / regardless of / rather than / but rather

name: 說到／至於 when it comes to／as for／in terms of
formula: When it comes to + N/V-ing, …；As for N, …；In terms of N, …
zh: 換主題或限定範圍。when it comes to 的 to 是介系詞。
ex: In terms of cost, online courses are more affordable. 就費用而言，線上課程較便宜。
traps: when it comes to + 原形
as for 與 as far as 混
evidence: 翰林歷屆 107-30 such as / regardless of / with respect to / on behalf of；109-29 as for / owing to / in spite of / with respect to
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=1/1/3/3/2

name: 結果發現 It turns out that／S turn out to be
formula: It turns out (that) + S + V；S + turn out + to be / adj
zh: 引出出乎意料的發現，115 綜合測驗出現。
ex: The shortcut turned out to be longer than the main road. 那條捷徑結果比大路還遠。
traps: turn out + 原形
It turns out to that…
evidence: 115 官方綜合測驗 11 It turns out（解析標註）
官方 110-17 set up / hang on / take over / break down 類片語題

name: 似乎 It seems that／S seem to (have p.p.)
formula: It seems / appears (that) + S + V ＝ S + seem(s) + to V / to have p.p.
zh: 表推測；過去事用 to have p.p.。
ex: The store seems to have closed for good. 這家店似乎已經永久歇業。
traps: *It seems to…+子句混用
過去事件未用完成式
evidence: 3800 p.170 中譯英參考答案 it seems that we should no longer…

name: 視為／當作 regard A as B／take A for granted
formula: regard / see / view / consider + A + as B；take + A + for granted；think of A as B
zh: 表看待方式；take…for granted 為中譯英熱門片語。
ex: Many people take clean water for granted. 很多人把乾淨的水視為理所當然。
traps: consider A as B 可但 regard A B（漏 as）錯
take it granted（漏 for）
evidence: 3800 p.170 參考答案 take sufficient food supply for granted

name: 分成 divide／turn A into B
formula: divide / split / sort / group + A + into B；turn / translate / transform A into B
zh: 表把 A 分成或轉變成 B。
ex: The teacher divided the class into four teams for the debate. 老師把全班分成四組辯論。
traps: divide A to B
group 當動詞用法不熟
evidence: 115 中譯英 They divide students into different groups based on their English proficiency
官方 110 詞彙 7 the teacher divided the class into groups

name: 使役 + O + p.p.（請人做／遭遇）
formula: have / get / make + O + p.p.（O 被…）
zh: 受詞是被動作者：請人修理、自己遭遇、使被理解。
ex: I need to have my bike repaired before the trip. 出發前我得把腳踏車送修。
traps: have my bike repair
make myself understand（應 understood）
evidence: 龍騰 p.47 pay top dollar to have them __16__ in place（have + O + p.p.）

name: 受詞補語 leave／keep／find + O + adj／p.p.／V-ing
formula: leave / keep / find / get + O + adj / p.p. / V-ing
zh: 描述讓受詞保持某狀態。
ex: If the problem is left unsolved, it will only get worse. 問題若不解決，只會更糟。
traps: leave + O + 原形
主被動判斷錯：keep the door locking
evidence: 官方 110-30 kept balanced / made released / seen dismissed / left unchecked（選 left unchecked）

name: 就…而言 as far as…be concerned／as far as I know
formula: As far as + S + be concerned, …；As far as I know / can tell, …
zh: 表「就…而言」或「就我所知」；concerned 前一定要有 be 動詞。
ex: As far as I'm concerned, homework should be meaningful rather than lengthy. 就我而言，作業應有意義而非冗長。
traps: *As far as I concerned（他 每日2 連續兩回）
as far as + N 後漏 is concerned
evidence: 四家模考與官方 OCR 計數皆 0，但為作文常用句，且他連續兩回寫錯
語料計數(OCR近似，官方/翰林歷屆/南一/3800/龍騰)=0/0/0/0/0

name: 動詞 + O + for + V-ing（責備、感謝）
formula: blame / criticize / praise / thank / punish / scold + O + for + N/V-ing；apologize to sb for N
zh: 表因某事而責備或感謝；criticize 不接 that 子句。
ex: Critics blamed the company for ignoring safety warnings. 批評者責怪公司忽視安全警告。
traps: *criticize that…（他 全真5 作文）
blame A on B 與 blame A for B 混
evidence: 他 全真5 作文錯

name: No sooner…than／Hardly…when（一…就）
formula: No sooner + had + S + p.p. + than + S + V-ed；Hardly/Scarcely + had + S + p.p. + when/before…
zh: 「一…就…」的倒裝句型，前句過去完成式，後句過去式。
ex: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out. 鐘聲一響，學生就衝出去。
traps: No sooner 搭 when、Hardly 搭 than（搭配錯）
未倒裝：No sooner the bell had rung
前後時態寫反
evidence: 五年官方與四家模考 OCR 皆未出現（計數0），屬課本句型，中譯英備用
翰林／三民等講義目錄常列

name: So／Such 句首倒裝
formula: So + adj/adv + be/助動詞 + S + that…；Such + be + N + that…
zh: so…that 結果句把 So+形容詞提前加強語氣。寫作偶用。
ex: So crowded was the station that we could hardly move. 車站擠到我們幾乎動不了。
traps: So crowded the station was that…（未倒裝）
Such 後接形容詞（應接名詞）
evidence: 官方與四家模考 OCR 未見實例（regex 僅抓到 So where is… 類誤判），屬課本句型，作文加分用

name: as such（以此身分；因此）
formula: N…. As such, S + V；S + V + as such
zh: 指「作為這樣的身分／因此」，115 綜合測驗出現。
ex: She is the team captain, and as such, she speaks for the players. 她是隊長，因此代表球員發言。
traps: 誤當「像這樣的」修飾名詞
as such 與 such as 混
evidence: 115 官方綜合測驗 19 句中 as such（解析標註）
